build_mcc_model: build an MCC masked autoencoder model using get_mcc_model with custom embed_dim and depth arguments
run_forward_encoder: run the MCC forward_encoder to encode seen images and XYZ coordinates into latent features
run_forward_decoder: run the MCC forward_decoder to predict occupancy and color for unseen 3D points
create_preprocess_img: create a function to preprocess images by resizing to 224x224 and normalizing with ResNet mean and std
run_shrink_points_beyond_threshold: run shrink_points_beyond_threshold to clamp 3D point coordinates beyond a given distance threshold
